name: Majority Completion of a Nested Extension
statement: For $\emptyset\ne S\subseteq B\subseteq\{0,1\}^n$, let $F(S)$ be the smallest ambient coordinate face containing $S$, put $E(B,S)=(B\times\{0\})\cup(S\times\{1\})$, and write $H=\operatorname{med}(B)$. Then $\operatorname{med}(E(B,S))=(H\times\{0\})\cup((H\cap F(S))\times\{1\})$, and $\delta_{\mathrm{med}}(E(B,S))=\delta_{\mathrm{med}}(B)+\delta_{\mathrm{med}}(S)+|\operatorname{med}(B)\cap F(S)|-|\operatorname{med}(S)|$. The last term is nonnegative.
proof: The pairwise patterns on old coordinates are exactly those of $B$, forcing the old word into $H$. At new-coordinate value zero, mixed pairs impose only the unary projections of $B$; at value one, they impose the unary projections of $S$, which cut out $F(S)$. Majority terms from $S$ lie in $H$ and preserve every coordinate constant on $S$, so $\operatorname{med}(S)\subseteq H\cap F(S)$. Counting the two layers and subtracting $|B|+|S|$ gives the defect formula.
comments: If $B$ and $S$ are isometric median classes, the extension is median exactly when $S=B\cap F(S)$. The formula also applies to nonmedian and disconnected inputs.
